near.title: 8. INDEMNIFICATION, LIMITATION OF LIABILITY AND INSURANCE (cont. 3)

m08.quote: 6.2 Insofar as one party processes personal data on behalf of the other, the parties conclude a separate data processing agreement pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR, which forms an integral part of this Agreement.
flags: checker_rejected: The quote refers to concluding a separate data processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR and does not mention any limitation of liability, caps, exclusions of damages, or time limits for claims.

clauses.label: Limitation of liability
clauses.rationale: The contract does not contain any clause limiting liability by amount, damage type exclusion, or claim time limit.

clauses.label: Consumer terms in checkout
clauses.quote: 3.1 Der Händler zeigt im Checkout den verpflichtenden Zahlarten-Text an und verlinkt auf die jeweils aktuellen Allgemeinen Geschäftsbedingungen des Anbieters für Verbraucher sowie dessen Datenschutzhinweise für das jeweilige Land.
clauses.rationale: The merchant must display and link the provider's consumer terms and privacy notices in the checkout.

clauses.label: Data processing agreement (Art. 28 GDPR)
clauses.rationale: The contract only states both parties comply with data protection laws but does not mention a data processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR.

clauses.label: Sub-processors
clauses.rationale: No provisions about sub-processor engagement or related authorizations are present.

clauses.label: Audit and inspection rights
clauses.rationale: No audit or inspection rights related to data processing or compliance are included.
